title: BRIEF-Tim Cook Says Trade War Tension With U.S. Created "Sharp Downturn" For China's Economy- CNBC
text:
BRIEF-Tim Cook Says Trade War Tension With U.S. Created "Sharp Downturn" For China's Economy- CNBC Jan 8 (Reuters) -
* APPLE CEO TIM COOK SAYS TRADE WAR TENSION WITH U.S. CREATED "SHARP DOWNTURN" FOR CHINA'S ECONOMY - CNBC INTERVIEW
* APPLE CEO TIM COOK SAYS INDIA IS A MAJOR FOCUS FOR CO
* APPLE CEO TIM COOK SAYS HAVE BEEN NOT BEEN IN ANY SETTLEMENT DISCUSSIONS WITH QUALCOMM SINCE THIRD CALENDAR QUARTER OF LAST YEAR
* APPLE CEO TIM COOK SAYS ISSUE THAT WE HAVE WITH QUALCOMM IS THAT THEY HAVE POLICY OF "NO LICENSE, NO CHIPS"
* APPLE CEO TIM COOK SAYS THERE ARE OVER 500 MILLION DEVICES USING SIRI, SIRI IS USED OVER 10 BILLION TIMES A MONTH
* APPLE CEO TIM COOK SAYS WILL ANNOUNCE NEW SERVICES THIS YEAR, WHICH WILL BE MATERIAL OVER TIME Further company coverage: AAPL.O
